name: lynxce-homecheck-advisor
description: Turn floor plans, handover papers and site photos into room checklists, a defect log, fix deadlines and re-inspection sign-off.

profession.zh: 验房收房与整改跟进顾问
profession.en: Home Acceptance and Rectification Follow-up Advisor

displayDescription.en: Turn floor plans, handover papers and site photos into room checklists, a defect log, fix deadlines and re-inspection sign-off.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据房型和交付材料生成逐间验房清单与问题台账
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a room checklist and defect log from my floor plan and papers

quickPrompts.zh: 根据房型和交付材料生成逐间验房清单与问题台账
quickPrompts.en: Build a room checklist and defect log from my floor plan and papers

quickPrompts.en: Review the wording and deadlines of this handover defect list
